QUOTE: `ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` builds `tool:<first arg value or *>` and calls `PermissionManager::is_allowed`, which returns true on the first allow pattern that matches.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names PermissionManager but never says its allow/deny lists come from the PermissionsConfig that ServerManager is constructed with. It only mentions the YAML loader and `permissions.allow`/`permissions.deny`.
